IS: 12323-1988 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

CIRCULAR SCREWING DIES FOR PARALLEL 

PIPE THREADS, G SERIES 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for hand and machine operated circular 
screwing dies for parallel pipe threads ( G series ) according to IS : 2643 Dimensions for pipe threads 
for fastening purposes: Part 1 (1975) Basic profile and dimensions; Part 2 ( 1975 ) Tolerances 
( first revision ); and Part 3 ( 1 975 ) Limits of sizes ( first revision ).

3. General Requirements 

3.1 The circular screwing dies for parallel pipe G series threads shall be provided with chamfer on 
both sides. 

3.2 The dimensions of pipe threads for dies shall be such as to produce pipe threads within the 
specified tolerance as given in IS : 2643 ( Parts 1 to 3 )-1975 'Dimensions for pipe threads for fastening 
purposes' for parallel threads. 

3.3 For requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to IS : 12320-1988 'Technical 
supply conditions for circular screwing dies'. 

4. Designation 

4.1 A circular screwing die for cutting parallel pipe threads { G series), having nominal size 1/2, made 
of high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Circular Screwing Die G1/2 IS : 12323 HSS 

5. Sampling— The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be according to IS: 7778-1975 
'Methods for sampling small tools'. 

6. Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The requirements of thread cutting dies were earlier covered under IS : 1859-1961 'Specification 
for thread cutting dies'. IS : 1859 is being modified and replaced by a series of standards to include 
various requirements pertaining to screwing dies which have been felt necessary at the national and 
international level. The title of the standard is also being modified as 'Circular screwing dies' in place 
of Thread cutting dies' so as to bring it in line with the terminology agreed to at the international level. 

The series of standards are as follows: 

IS : 12319-1988 General dimensions for circular screwing dies 

IS : 1 2320-1 988 Technical supply conditions for circular screwing dies 

IS : 12321-1988 Circular screwing dies for ISO metric screw threads 

IS : 12322-1988 Circular screwing dies for taper pipe threads — R series 

IS : 12323-1988 Circular screwing dies for parallel pipe threads — G series 

IS : 12324-1988 Hexagonal die nuts 

IS : 12325-1988 Circular screwing dies for ISO metric conduit pipe threads 

On the publication of above standards, IS : 1859 will stand withdrawn. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from: 

a) ISO 2568-1973 Hand- and machine-operated circular screwing dies and hand operated die 

stocks. International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 

b) ISO 4231-1987 Hand- and machine-operated circular screwing dies parallel pipe threads — 

G-series International Organization for Standardization ( ISO). 

c) DIN 5158-1986 Circular screwing dies for parallel pipe threads G 1/16 A to G 21 /4A 

Deutsches Institut fiir Normung ( DIN ). 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
